## Setup

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

cfg <- list(
  data_dir = file.path("data", "5min"),
  timezone = "UTC",
  analysis_start_date = as.Date("2025-03-01"),
  particle_mass_max = 1000
)
```

## Data import

Study window: `2025-03-01 < date < Sys.Date()` (UTC), with one row per `userId` and `bucket_5min`.

```{r, message=FALSE}
if (!exists("myair_5min", inherits = FALSE)) {
  myair_5min <- read_csv(
    file.path(cfg$data_dir, "myair_5min.csv.gz"),
    col_types = cols(userId = col_character(), bucket_5min = col_datetime(), deviceId = col_character(), firmware = col_character()),
    locale = locale(tz = "UTC"), na = c("", "NA", "NULL"), show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}
air <- myair_5min
air <- air %>%
  filter(
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) > cfg$analysis_start_date,
    as.Date(bucket_5min, tz = cfg$timezone) < Sys.Date()
  )
```

## Variable selection

```{r}
air <- air %>%
  transmute(
    userId,
    bucket_5min,

    temperature = temperature_mean,
    temperature_min,
    temperature_max,

    humidity = humidity_mean,
    humidity_min,
    humidity_max,

    pm1 = pm1_mean,
    pm25 = pm25_mean,
    pm10 = pm10_mean,

    pc03 = pc03_mean,
    pc05 = pc05_mean,
    pc1 = pc1_mean,
    pc25 = pc25_mean,
    pc5 = pc5_mean,
    pc10 = pc10_mean,

    uvb = uvb_mean,
    light = light_mean
  )
```

## Particle measurements quality control

Cumulative particle counts should decrease with increasing size threshold:

$$
\mathrm{PC}_{0.3} \geq
\mathrm{PC}_{0.5} \geq
\mathrm{PC}_{1.0} \geq
\mathrm{PC}_{2.5} \geq
\mathrm{PC}_{5.0} \geq
\mathrm{PC}_{10}
$$

A five-minute particle block is classified as invalid when:

- the cumulative particle-count ordering is violated;
- at least one particulate-mass value exceeds the exploratory upper screening
  threshold of `r cfg$particle_mass_max` µg/m³.

Both conditions mask all PM/PC values because they share a sensor block.

The mass threshold is exploratory, not a validated exposure limit; confirm it against sensor specifications before inference.

```{r}
air <- air %>%
  mutate(
    invalid_particle_order = coalesce(
      pc03 < pc05 |
        pc05 < pc1 |
        pc1 < pc25 |
        pc25 < pc5 |
        pc5 < pc10,
      FALSE
    ),

    invalid_particle_mass = coalesce(
      pm1 > cfg$particle_mass_max |
        pm25 > cfg$particle_mass_max |
        pm10 > cfg$particle_mass_max,
      FALSE
    ),

    invalid_particles =
      invalid_particle_order |
      invalid_particle_mass,

    pm1 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pm1),
    pm25 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pm25),
    pm10 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pm10),

    pc03 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc03),
    pc05 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc05),
    pc1 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc1),
    pc25 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc25),
    pc5 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc5),
    pc10 = if_else(invalid_particles, NA_real_, pc10)
  )
```

## Quality-control summary

```{r}
air %>%
  count(
    invalid_particle_order,
    invalid_particle_mass,
    invalid_particles
  ) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "pipe",
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c(
      "Invalid count ordering",
      "Invalid particulate mass",
      "Invalid particle block",
      "Observations",
      "Percent"
    ),
    caption = "Particle quality-control classification"
  )
```
